data.tree_role: Complete historical23-order bird tree supplied as an estimated reference topology and branch lengths,not a new sequence analysis or a claim of a true phylogeny. Preserve every tip and edge. Serialization root is the declared reference root and has no stem. Tip labels are historical order labels,not sampled individual birds.
data.working_design_model: A proposed comparative study would estimate one unknown nonrandom ancestral mean mu from one future trait value at each supplied tip. Conditional on this fixed unknown root value, assume independent zero-mean increments on every branch with variance equal to its supplied branch length (unit diffusion coefficient1). Thus C[i,j] is the length shared by the root paths to tips i and j,including C[i,i]=root-to-tip height. This is an explicitly declared working covariance,not an empirical demonstration that real traits follow Brownian evolution. No trait observations or realized residuals are supplied or fabricated.
data.design_estimand: Evaluate the variance of the best linear unbiased constant-mean estimate under this working covariance: weights=C^-1*ones/(ones^T*C^-1*ones),and variance=1/(ones^T*C^-1*ones). Compare with treating the same tips as independent with their common root-to-tip marginal variance h: independent mean variance=h/tip_count. Define effective_independent_tip_count=h/working_gls_mean_variance,solely as this mean-variance ratio. Return all tip IDs tied within1e-12 for the largest and smallest GLS weights. Use parsed source tip order as the matrix column and coefficient basis; equation rows may reorder with their right-hand side.
data.branch_unit_scope: APE documents these branch lengths as derived from Delta T50H DNA/DNA hybridization values,not dated years. A root-path value is in those source branch units. Unit diffusion assigns trait-variance units per source branch unit by assumption. The effective count is dimensionless; it is not a literal number of independent experiments,a causal effect,a molecular-clock proof,an uncertainty bound on the tree or a population guarantee.

source_provenance.license: APE package GPL-2 or GPL-3; source attribution retained.
source_provenance.original_attribution: Sibley CG,Ahlquist JE(1990),Phylogeny and classification of birds,Yale University Press. Official APE dataset documentation and complete R object were read; original book was not read in full.
source_provenance.export: All23 tip labels and44 positive branch lengths from the original APE phylo object are serialized into Newick in original child order. Original R root node24 is the serialization root; representation node numbers may change. No edge was fitted,pruned,duplicated or altered; no GLS weights,covariance or answers appear in public data.
source_provenance.decoder: rdata0.11.2 pure-Python original RDA decoding,not R code execution. Known phylo constructor fallback exposes the original edge/tip/branch arrays.
decoder_warnings: Missing constructor for R class "phylo". The underlying R object is returned instead.
source_provenance.branch_length_definition: Official bird.orders.Rd describes Delta T50H values from Sibley/Ahlquist figure353; no time calibration or actual species trait dataset is imported.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
